claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh v0.15.162 GPT-5.4-mini Python ZIP/log evidence that locally regraded at 97/A because assessment labels and weights became lesson/file/source identities.
Course Map topic selection treats assessment labels with grade weights as weak identities and does not reuse them as lesson topics.
proofCommands: rg -n "isAssessmentLabelCourseMapIdentity|isWeakCourseMapTopic|assessment labels with grade weights" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js

claims.summary: Computer Science/Python Course Map repair has a 15-lesson progression fallback for concrete programming concepts.
proofCommands: rg -n "COMPUTER_SCIENCE_TOPIC_SEQUENCE|variables, expressions|project presentation and code review" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js

claims.summary: Readiness repair catches embedded assessment-label identities inside complete-looking Course Map cells before graph/export derivation.
The focused regression uses the exact v0.15.162 failure shape and proves repaired Course Map cells plus graph identities have no assessment-label or grade-weight leakage.
proofCommands: rg -n "repairs assessment-label course-title identities|Evidence check: Introduction to Computer Science with Python" tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js
